mapper.insert: insert into internship_reflection (student_id, student_name, student_user_id, content, remark, internship_status_id, stage_assignment_id, period_number, task_type, deadline, counselor_id, submit_time, ai_keywords, ai_analysis, ai_improvements, ai_score, ai_analysis_time, status, create_time, update_time, deleted) values (#{studentId}, #{studentName}, #{studentUserId}, #{content}, #{remark}, #{internshipStatusId}, #{stageAssignmentId}, #{periodNumber}, #{taskType}, #{deadline}, #{counselorId}, #{submitTime}, #{aiKeywords}, #{aiAnalysis}, #{aiImprovements}, #{aiScore}, #{aiAnalysisTime}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{deleted})
mapper.update: UPDATE internship_reflection SET status = 0, remark = '0', ai_keywords = NULL, ai_analysis = NULL, ai_improvements = NULL, ai_score = NULL, ai_analysis_time = NULL, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND student_id = #{studentId} AND deleted = 0 AND remark IS NULL
mapper.select: select ir.*, su.id as su_id, su.name as su_name, su.student_user_id as su_student_id, su.gender as su_gender, su.grade as su_grade, su.major_id as su_major_id, su.class_id as su_class_id from internship_reflection ir left join student_users su on ir.student_id = su.id where ir.id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM internship_reflection WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM student_reflection_evaluation WHERE reflection_id = #{reflectionId} AND total_score IS NOT NULL)
mapper.update: UPDATE internship_reflection SET status = 10, remark = NULL'0', update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND remark IS NULL
mapper.sql: (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(submission.id), 0) FROM internship_progress_record submission WHERE submission.related_id = ir.id AND submission.student_id = ir.student_id AND submission.event_type IN ('reflection_submitted', 'reflection_resubmitted', 'reflection_submit', 'reflection_withdrawn'))
mapper.select: SELECT ir.id FROM internship_reflection ir INNER JOIN student_users su ON su.id = ir.student_id WHERE ir.deleted = 0 AND ir.status = 0 AND ir.remark IS NULL AND ir.submit_time IS NOT NULL AND ir.content IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(ir.content) != '' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM student_reflection_ai_analysis analysis WHERE analysis.reflection_id = ir.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM student_reflection_evaluation evaluation WHERE evaluation.reflection_id = ir.id AND evaluation.total_score IS NOT NULL) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM class_counselor_relation relation INNER JOIN teacher_users counselor ON counselor.id = relation.counselor_id AND counselor.status = 1 AND counselor.teacher_type = 'COUNSELOR' INNER JOIN counselor_ai_settings settings ON settings.counselor_id = relation.counselor_id WHERE relation.class_id = su.class_id AND settings.enable_ai_scoring = 1) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM internship_progress_record failure WHERE failure.related_id = ir.id AND failure.student_id = ir.student_id AND failure.event_type = 'reflection_ai_failed' AND failure.status = CAST( AS CHAR)) < #{maxAttempts} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM internship_progress_record failure WHERE failure.related_id = ir.id AND failure.student_id = ir.student_id AND failure.event_type = 'reflection_ai_failed' AND failure.status = CAST( AS CHAR) AND failure.create_time > DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{retryDelaySeconds} SECOND)) ORDER BY ir.submit_time, ir.id LIMIT #{limit}
